label: Each actual identity bearer has an exercise with no prior exercise of that same bearer
paraphrase: On the fixed q3a4 profile and exercise interpretation, each actual bearer r whose represented esse is its essence has an eligible exercise f with bearer f = r. No eligible exercise borne by r has a nonempty path in the exercise relation C to f, including f itself. The claim concerns paths with arbitrary intermediate bearers. Other bearers may have exercises earlier than f, and r may have infinitely many exercises or more than one such minimal exercise.
